performance_issues.description: Filesystem directory rename is performed inside the transaction commit path. If the filesystem is slow (NFS), this blocks the request.
performance_issues.impact: Request latency increases with filesystem I/O time; transaction held open during rename
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider performing filesystem rename after transaction commit with rollback logic

optimization_recommendations.implementation: Merge UpdateOrgEmailAddress into the UpdateUser call by including email in UpdateOptions

performance_issues.description: Filesystem removal (util.RemoveAll) and avatar storage deletion happen synchronously after the transaction commits
performance_issues.impact: If storage is slow, request latency increases. However, since this is a rare destructive operation, impact is minimal.
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider async cleanup of filesystem/storage after successful DB deletion
